hooks.command: j=$(git diff --name-only HEAD -- src/main/java 2>/dev/null | wc -l); d=$(git diff --name-only HEAD -- .claude/skills .claude/rules DEVELOPER.md CLAUDE.md 2>/dev/null | wc -l); if [ "$j" -gt 0 ] && [ "$d" -eq 0 ]; then echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"Java files changed this session but no docs (.claude/skills, .claude/rules, DEVELOPER.md, CLAUDE.md) were touched — check if any need updating (wire protocol IDs, API surface, config options, panel/color inventories).\"}"; fi
